end.summary:
Asha practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Ayaan identified triangles as having three sides and three corners.
Ayaan named square and diamond shapes and stated four corners for a square.
Ayaan explained that a corner is where two sides meet.
Ayaan sometimes lost track while counting around a shape and counted a side twice; this was not corrected after the last time seen.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, naming shapes from their features, and explaining what a corner means. Ayaan used the idea that two sides meet at a corner and correctly named several four-sided shapes. They mixed up the count when a shape changed and sometimes counted a side twice; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw simple shapes and have Ayaan touch each side or corner once while counting aloud and marking the starting point.
